customManagers.description: The upstream Vortex release this implementation follows

packageRules.description: A new Vortex release is work to do, not a version to merge. The autoimplement label marks it. Nothing acts on that label alone: Florent adds the autopilot label to hand the PR to the agent.
prBodyNotes: This PR only changes `.vortex-version`. CI stays red until the Go implementation follows upstream `{{{currentVersion}}}` to `{{{newVersion}}}`. The procedure is in [docs/upstream-update.md](../blob/main/docs/upstream-update.md).
